_readme: Sponsor spot for Daily Design. The first entry with active=true (and today's date inside its optional start/end, YYYY-MM-DD) is the sponsor. Near the top of the index, report pages and editions there is a 4:1 landscape banner (1200x300) labelled Sponsored: the sponsor's banner image when banner.active is true and today is inside banner.start/end, otherwise a text card with its logo, name and line. With no active sponsor the banner shows a 'Your ad here' placeholder linking to contact.html, and a short 'Sponsor Daily Design' invite always sits below it. Fields: name, line (one short sentence), url (https), logo (an https URL or a repo path such as assets/sponsors/acme.png), active, start, end, and banner {image (https URL or repo path, 1200x300 PNG/JPG/WebP, max 300 KB), alt (text describing the ad), url (click URL, https; defaults to url), active, start, end}. Links get rel="sponsored noopener". Sponsors are display-only and never affect what is picked or how it ranks. Run tools/publish.py after editing. Banner spec: tools/PUBLISHING.md.

sponsors.name: Example Tool
sponsors.line: One short line about the sponsor.
